page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.s3 family. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, with 1.0 thread per core, indicating no hyperthreading. The instance is provisioned with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 1.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs, and the instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. Additionally, advanced CPU instruction sets such as AVX-512, AMX, and hardware-accelerated cryptography are not available on this hardware profile.

With a 1:1 ratio of vCPUs to memory, the ecs.s3.medium offers a compute-leaning resource allocation. The dedicated CPU assignment ensures consistent processing performance without the noisy-neighbor risks of shared-core environments, though the low memory capacity limits its use to lightweight, compute-centric tasks. It is suitable for basic web serving, lightweight microservices, and small-scale batch processing workloads that require dedicated CPU cycles but have minimal memory footprints.
